Decomposing the directive into sub-orchestrators, agent tasks, and handoffs.

Delegation tree:
• Config Discovery Orchestrator (Locate backend configuration artifacts)
    – Spring config scanner: Glob backend/src/main/resources for application*.yml/properties, bootstrap files, logback config, and profile-specific configs (dev, prod, render). List each file path with active profile and key sections (datasource, redis, kafka, elasticsearch, security).
    – Java @Configuration scanner: Grep backend/src/main/java for @Configuration, @ConfigurationProperties, and @EnableConfigurationProperties classes (e.g. CacheConfig, TenantAwareDataSourceConfig, security config). List each class with file path and one-line purpose.
• Infra Config Orchestrator (Cover build, container, and deployment config)
    – Build/deploy config scanner: List backend build and deployment configuration: pom.xml (key dependencies/plugins), Dockerfile, docker-compose files, k8s/helm manifests, GitHub Actions workflows touching the backend, and Flyway migration config. Note the purpose of each.
• Synthesis Orchestrator (Merge findings into final report)
    – Config catalog synthesizer: Merge outputs from spring-config-scanner, java-config-scanner, and build-deploy-scanner into a deduplicated table of backend configuration files grouped by category (runtime properties, Java config classes, build, container/deploy), each with path and purpose.
    ↳ handoffs: spring-config-scanner→config-synthesizer, java-config-scanner→config-synthesizer, build-deploy-scanner→config-synthesizer

**Build & deploy configuration inventory:**

- **`backend/pom.xml`** — Java 21, Spring Boot (web, security, JPA, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, websocket), Flyway+PostgreSQL, MapStruct, JJWT, Bucket4j, ShedLock, Micrometer/OTel, Testcontainers; plugins: spring-boot, surefire, JaCoCo. Depends on parent `nulogic-platform` + bundled `common-module`/`pm-module` JARs from `infra/mvn-local-deps/`.
- **`backend/Dockerfile`** — multi-stage Maven→Temurin 21 build; context = repo root (installs bundled JARs first).
- **`docker-compose.yml` / `.override.yml` / `.prod.yml`** (root) — local infra (PG, Redis, Kafka, ES, Prometheus) and prod variant.
- **`infra/deployment/`** — `helm/hrms` chart, `kubernetes/` raw manifests (backend deployment/service, HPA, ingress, network-policy), `kyverno/`, `cloudbuild.yaml`, `deploy.sh`.
- **CI:** `ci.yml` (backend/frontend/security jobs), `deploy.yml`, `pr-validation.yml`, `security-scan.yml`, `cosign-sign.yml`.
- **Flyway:** `application*.yml` — enabled by default, direct (non-pooler) `FLYWAY_URL`; disabled in `render` profile; 287 migrations.

Aggregating sub-orchestrator findings into a verdict.

**GO** — backend configuration is fully inventoried; findings are consistent and complete.

- **Runtime config:** 7 files in `backend/src/main/resources/` — base `application.yml` plus profile overrides (`dev`, `test`, `demo`, `prod`, `render` for Railway) and `logback-spring.xml`; Flyway on by default (287 migrations), disabled in `render` profile.
- **Java config:** ~31 `@Configuration` classes under `common/config` covering security (filter chain, SAML, password policy), data (JPA/RLS, read-replica routing, Redis caches), integrations (Kafka, Elasticsearch, Google Drive, email, AI, Twilio), WebSocket, scheduling/ShedLock, and observability.
- **Build/deploy:** `pom.xml` (Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5.14), multi-stage `Dockerfile`, root docker-compose variants, Helm chart + raw K8s manifests under `infra/deployment/`, five GitHub Actions workflows.
- **One discrepancy:** scanners disagree on `TenantAwareDataSourceConfig` being annotated `@Configuration` — verify before citing it; otherwise inventories align.
